name: many-eyes-pilot7
about: Pilot 7: blind feeding. The cycle 27 probe showed evolved herbivores are reactive (eat until a threat is sensed, then look up), which works because head-down detection was never zero. Here headDownSense = 0: a feeding animal detects nothing, so the only defences are proactive scanning and (with alarm) warnings from others, the situation the many-eyes effect is about. No alarm vs graded alarm (lambda 1/s); same seeds and setup as pilots 3-6; pilot 3's no-predator runs are the control. Predictions: vigilance rises off the 1-3% floor; with graded alarm, a negative food-adjusted slope steeper than the no-predator control.
